title: Baseline
description: The scenario as described in docs/DEMO_SCENARIO.md.

title: M. Verma is not the supplier-run releaser
description: Removes the runbook dependency, so disabling the account no longer stops Payment processing. The plan is expected to change.

title: Finance Ops owner unavailable
description: S. Iyer cannot approve and has no delegate, so the step-up cannot be authorised.

title: Finance users lack phishing-resistant methods
description: Step-up falls back to methods the attacker controls, so its cut becomes soft.

title: User-impact limit raised to 250
description: Guards against a plan that only wins because of the user limit.

title: AS64500 can be blocked on the support route
description: The identity provider can refuse AS64500 sign-ins to the support portal outright, so the edge block on that route (C09) becomes a hard cut. Nothing else changes; under Critical Asset Zero Tolerance a plan that also closes U1 becomes feasible.
